notes: kuna-fixes cases: classes Vineflower 1.12.0 fails on that a kuna fix decompiles. Each runs in compat and in default mode on the fixture's base map plus `options`; maintained by tests/jvm/kuna_fix_case.py, read by regen.py.

cases.summary: `objects` and `shapes`, which pass `factory::create` on a `Factory<?>`/`ShapeFactory<?>` receiver to a generic `map`, decompile to their source; the failure comments and bytecode listings are gone
`create` and `attempt`, whose `catch (Throwable)` handlers start with `if (!flag)`, decompile to their source; `read`, a try-with-resources on a nullable resource, is still rebuilt as one

`assertThenTryFinally` decompiles; `tryFinallyThenCode` and `tryCatchReturn` keep the code after the if on the path through the try (Vineflower skips it with a `break`), and `tryFinallyThenReturn` keeps its source shape; the recompiled class's `javap -c -p` equals the original's

the eight methods whose switch expression yields a string or class literal next to an arm of another reference type (a boxed char, int or boolean, a StringBuilder, a Class), as an argument, a returned value, a local and inside a lambda, decompile to their source; the failure comments and bytecode listings are gone

`read`, `readThree`, `readOrDefault`, `readGuarded` and `readFinally` (a `while (true)` after other code around a `try` whose two or three `catch` blocks all go back to the loop) decompile to their source, `readOrDefault`'s `break` as `return -1` in its `catch` block, the way Vineflower prints such a `break`; the failure comments and bytecode listings are gone

`iterator`, whose `object : Iterator<String>` captures the extension receiver and gets the parameterless `remove()` stub kotlinc adds, decompiles; `remove()` is written as a plain method instead of being taken for an extension of the captured receiver

`byLength`, `byLengthOf` (which creates `byLength`'s object), `nullsFirstBy` (two early `return@Comparator`s) and `twice` (a `crossinline` function-type lambda) decompile to `object` expressions whose methods return what the source returns; the failure comments are gone
`make`, whose object has a function and an inner class with a default computed by an inlined `map`, decompiles; those defaults print as unknown (`= ...`), the simple one as `n: Int = 7`

`twoDefaults` and `oneDefault`, whose objects' inner classes call the superclass through its default-arguments constructor, decompile with `: TestDefaultArgsSuperCall(x)` and `(x, y)`; `otherConstructor` still fails by design: `Overloaded` has a one-argument secondary constructor that `Overloaded(x)` would call

`sweep`, `lastOfHead`, `firstOf`, `itemLength` and `lengthOf`, which use a `Node` nested in the non-generic inner class `Itrs` of the generic class, decompile to their source, `E` mapped to `String` through `Itrs` where the instance is a `TestInnerOfGenericOuter<String>` one; the failure comments and bytecode listings are gone

the class, whose synthetic `body` creates the lambda it implements (as the constructor does), decompiles: both sites are written as `this::body`, and `body` stays a method (left out here, as every synthetic method is under `remove-synthetic`); `plain`'s ordinary lambda is still written in place

every `new DiamondLib(..)`/`new DiamondBox()` whose expected type is a `DiamondLib<..>`/`DiamondBox<..>` (static and instance fields, a local, returns, an assignment, arguments, a ternary operand, a generic class's field) is written `new C<>(..)`, so the lambdas get their `Object[]` parameters back and the class recompiles to identical bytecode; `Object OBJECT = new DiamondBox()` and the non-generic `DiamondPlain` stay as they are

`consistent`, `noFailure`, `unreachable` and `plain`, whose lambdas are a lone `assert`, get block bodies; `drain`, whose inner loop ends with an `assert`, stays a `while` loop with the `assert` at the end of its body; Vineflower prints both in expression positions, which javac rejects

the inner anonymous class's call of its enclosing anonymous class's static `twice` is written `twice(value)`, not `<unrepresentable>.twice(value)`; the call of a named class's static method keeps its qualifier

the dead `throw new AssertionError(...)` statements after `return` in `spans` and `widths` are gone, and `widths` declares its for-each variable in the header (`for (int[] row : rows)`, was `for (row : rows)`)
the enums without constants, `TestEnumNoConstants` and `Only`, start their bodies with the `;` Java requires before members; `Empty` (no members) is unchanged

`once`, `twice` and `early`, suspend functions whose try/finally spans a suspension point, decompile: the try of the tail keeps its inlined finally and each range part the exception deobfuscator split off becomes a try/finally guarded by a semaphore variable

`describe`, two record deconstruction patterns inside a try/catch, decompiles to its source (one try, the second pattern in a conditional expression); recompiled with javac its bytecode equals the original's

`drain` (a suspend loop inside try/catch/finally) and `first` decompile; the loop body irreducible-flow splitting copies for the resume path keeps its finally, guarded by the same semaphore variable (with the fixes handler_copy_offsets and nested_handler_copies)
case Kind.CIRCLE beside type patterns in a switch on an interface: the enum label is resolved and printed qualified

cases with several labels (case Integer _, String _; case Kind.CIRCLE, Kind.SQUARE; case 5, 7) and an integer label equal to a later switch index: every label is resolved, multi-pattern cases print as one unnamed-pattern label
case 42 beside case Integer i when ... on an Integer, String or Character selector (no checkcast, no LocalVariableTable): the pattern is typed by its class, the selector keeps its type
a @JvmOverloads overload and the function of an object written inside a lambda return their values (Vineflower prints the values as bare expression statements)
a DefaultImpls method whose body fails is printed with its failure comment (Vineflower leaves it out of the class without a trace)
an object expression's superclass is written with its constructor arguments, object : Base(k + 1, s) (Vineflower prints object : Base)
